$comment: Files Greptile pre-loads as review context. Entries WITHOUT a scope load on every review; entries WITH a scope load only when the file under review matches one of the globs (keeps context focused per surface). Greptile already indexes the whole repo automatically — this is about PRIORITIZING the highest-signal intent/context docs, not making files visible.
